cve_id: CVE-2021-40417
vulnerability_title: Blackmagic Design DaVinci Resolve R3D DPDecoder Service frame decoding heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability
affected_software: Blackmagic Design DaVinci Resolve 17.3.1.0005
vendor: Blackmagic Design
cwe_type: CWE-680 - Integer Overflow to Buffer Overflow
cvss_vector: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H
attack_vector: Network
vulnerability_summary: When parsing a file that is submitted to the DPDecoder service as a job, the service will use the combination of decoding parameters that were submitted with the job along with fields that were parsed for the submitted video by the R3D SDK to calculate the size of a heap buffer. Due to an integer overflow with regards to this calculation, this can result in an undersized heap buffer being allocated. When this heap buffer is written to, a heap-based buffer overflow will occur. This can result in code execution under the context of the application.
discovery_credit: Discovered by a member of Cisco Talos.
disclosure_timeline: {'vendor_disclosure': '2021-12-09', 'public_release': '2021-12-20'}
product_reference_url: http://www.blackmagicdesign.com/products/davinciresolve

report_id: TALOS-2018-0650
cve_id: CVE-2018-3982
vulnerability_title: Atlantis Word Processor document endnote reference code execution vulnerability
affected_software: [{'product_name': 'Atlantis Word Processor', 'tested_versions': ['3.0.2.3', '3.0.2.5']}]
vendor: Atlantis Word Processor
cwe_type: CWE-129: Improper Validation of Array Index
cvss_vector: CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H
attack_vector: Network
vulnerability_summary: An exploitable arbitrary write vulnerability exists in the Word document parser of the Atlantis word processor. A specially crafted document can prevent Atlas from adding elements to an array that is indexed by a loop. When reading from this array, the application will use an out-of-bounds index which can result in arbitrary data being read as a pointer. Later, when the application attempts to write to said pointer, an arbitrary write will occur. This can allow an attacker to further corrupt memory, which leads to code execution under the context of the application. An attacker must convince a victim to open a document in order to trigger this vulnerability.
discovery_credit: Discovered by a member of Cisco Talos.
disclosure_timeline: {'vendor_disclosure': '2018-09-10', 'patch_release': '2018-09-11', 'vendor_release': '2018-09-26', 'public_disclosure': '2018-10-01'}

vulnerability_title: Nitro Pro XRefTable Entry Missing Object Code Execution Vulnerability
affected_software: Nitro Pro 13.13.2.242, Nitro Pro 13.16.2.300
vendor: Nitro Software, Inc.
cwe_type: CWE-416 - Use After Free
cvss_vector: CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H
attack_vector: Network
vulnerability_summary: An exploitable vulnerability exists in the cross-reference table repairing functionality of Nitro Pro 13.13.2.242. input:
report_id: TALOS-2016-0197
cve_id: CVE-2017-2790
vulnerability_title: Ichitaro Office Excel File Code Execution Vulnerability
affected_software: JustSystems Ichitaro
vendor: JustSystems
cwe_type: N/A
cvss_vector: CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H
attack_vector: Network
vulnerability_summary: A vulnerability was discovered within the Ichitaro word processor. Ichitaro is published by JustSystems and is considered one of the more popular word processors used within Japan. Ichitaro handles Microsoft Excel’s .xls file format. When processing a record type of 0x3c from a Workbook stream from an .xls, the application trusts that the size is greater than zero, subtracts one from the length, and uses this result as the size for a memcpy. This results in a heap-based buffer overflow and can lead to code-execution under the context of the application.
discovery_credit: Discovered by a Talos team member and Cory Duplantis of Cisco Talos.

vulnerability_title: Intel IGC64.DLL shader functionality realloc code execution vulnerability
affected_software: Intel IGC64.DLL (Intel Graphics Shader Compiler for Intel(R) Graphics Accelerator), version 26.20.100.7584
vendor: Intel
cwe_type: CWE-590: Free of Memory not on the Heap

This vulnerability could potentially be triggered from guest machines running on virtualization environments (e.g. VMware, QEMU, VirtualBox etc.) in order to perform guest-to-host escape. affected_software: SoftMaker Software GmbH SoftMaker Office PlanMaker 2021 (Revision 1014)

vulnerability_title: Iceni Argus PDF Uninitialized WordStyle Color Length Code Execution Vulnerability
affected_software: Iceni Argus Version 6.6.04
vendor: Iceni
cwe_type: N/A
cvss_vector: CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H
attack_vector: Network
vulnerability_summary: An exploitable uninitialized variable vulnerability which leads to a stack-based buffer overflow exists in Iceni Argus. When it attempts to convert a malformed PDF to XML a stack variable will be left uninitialized which will later be used to fetch a length that is used in a copy operation. In most cases this will allow an aggressor to write outside the bounds of a stack buffer which is used to contain colors. report_id: TALOS-2020-1040
cve_id: CVE-2020-6100
vulnerability_title: AMD Radeon DirectX 11 Driver atidxx64.dll Shader Functionality MOV REG Code Execution Vulnerability
affected_software: AMD atidxx64.dll (26.20.15019.19000)
vendor: AMD
cwe_type: CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write
cvss_vector: CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H
attack_vector: Network
vulnerability_summary: An exploitable memory corruption vulnerability exists in AMD atidxx64.dll graphics driver. A specially crafted pixel shader can cause memory corruption vulnerability. An attacker can provide a specially crafted shader file to trigger this vulnerability. This vulnerability potentially could be triggered from guest machines running virtualization environments (ie. VMware, qemu, VirtualBox etc.) in order to perform guest-to-host escape - as it was demonstrated before (TALOS-2018-0533, TALOS-2018-0568, etc.). Theoretically this vulnerability could be also triggered from web browser (using webGL and webassembly). We were able to trigger this vulnerability from HYPER-V guest using RemoteFX feature leading to executing the vulnerable code on the HYPER-V host (inside of the rdvgm.exe process).
discovery_credit: Discovered by Piotr Bania of Cisco Talos.
disclosure_timeline: {'vendor_disclosure': '2020-03-31', 'public_release': '2020-07-14'}
product_reference_url: http://amd.com
output: [{"evidence": ["CWE-787 indicates an out-of-bounds write leading to memory corruption", "CVSS vector shows network attack vector with high impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability", "Attack complexity is high but requires low privileges and no user interaction", "Exploitability includes guest-to-host escape in virtualization environments", "Impact includes remote code execution on host systems"], "analysis": "First check the CWE type indicating memory corruption via out-of-bounds write; then verify the CVSS vector showing network attack vector with high impact and low privileges required; finally confirm the vulnerability enables remote code execution through crafted shaders and virtualization escape because it leads to execution of arbitrary code on the host, classify as code_execution", "official": "code_execution", "severity": "high", "action": "block"}]

cve_id: CVE-2017-2789
vulnerability_title: Ichitaro Office JTD Figure handling Code Execution Vulnerability
affected_software: JustSystems Ichitaro
vendor: JustSystems
cwe_type: N/A
cvss_vector: CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H
attack_vector: Network
vulnerability_summary: A heap-based buffer overflow occurs in the Ichitaro word processor when processing a Figure stream from a .jtd file. The application allocates a buffer and calculates two values to determine how much data to copy. If both values exceed the buffer size, the smaller is trusted and used, but this value is still larger than the buffer, leading to overflow. This corrupts heap offsets used in pointer arithmetic and can result in code execution under the application context.
discovery_credit: Discovered by a Talos team member and Cory Duplantis of Cisco Talos.
disclosure_timeline: 2016-08-29 - Vendor Disclosure; 2017-02-24 - Public Release

cve_id: CVE-2019-10310
vulnerability_title: Jenkins Ansible Tower Plugin information disclosure vulnerability
affected_software: Jenkins Ansible Tower Plugin 0.9.1
vendor: Jenkins
cwe_type: CWE-285: Improper Authorization
cvss_vector: CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:N/A:N
attack_vector: Network
vulnerability_summary: An exploitable information disclosure vulnerability exists in the testTowerConnection function of the Jenkins Ansible Tower Plugin 0.9.1. A specially crafted HTTP request from a user with Overall/Read permissions - such as an anonymous user, if enabled - can cause affected versions of this plugin to disclose credentials from the Jenkins credentials database to an attacker-controlled server. This vulnerability is exploitable through HTTP GET requests and may also be exploited via Cross Site Request Forgery (CSRF). Additionally, improper JSON response handling can lead to reflected Server Side Request Forgery (SSRF). The fillTowerCredentialsIdItems endpoint also allows enumeration of credential identifiers required for the attack.
discovery_credit: Discovered by Peter Adkins of Cisco Umbrella.
disclosure_timeline: {'vendor_disclosure': '2019-03-12', 'vendor_patch': '2019-04-30', 'public_release': '2019-05-06'}
product_reference_url: https://plugins.jenkins.io/ansible-tower

report_id: TALOS-2018-0730
cve_id: CVE-2018-4056
vulnerability_title: coTURN Administrator Web Portal SQL injection vulnerability
affected_software: coTURN 4.5.0.5
vendor: Cisco
cwe_type: CWE-89: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command (‘SQL Injection’)
cvss_vector: CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:H/A:H
attack_vector: Network
vulnerability_summary: An exploitable SQL injection vulnerability exists in the administrator web portal function of coTURN prior to version 4.5.0.9. A login message with a specially crafted username can cause an SQL injection, resulting in authentication bypass, which could give access to the TURN server administrator web portal. An attacker can log in via the external interface of the TURN server to trigger this vulnerability.
discovery_credit: Discovered by Nicolas Edet of Cisco.
disclosure_timeline: {'vendor_disclosure': '2017-09-04', 'public_disclosure': '2019-01-29'}
product_reference_url: https://github.com/coturn/coturn

cve_id: ['CVE-2015-7974', 'CVE-2016-1567']
vulnerability_title: Network Time Protocol Skeleton Key: Symmetric Authentication Impersonation Vulnerability
affected_software: NTP 4.2.8p3, NTPsec a5fb34b9cc89b92a8fef2f459004865c93bb7f92, chrony 2.2
vendor: NTP Project
cwe_type: N/A
cvss_vector: None
attack_vector: network
vulnerability_summary: Symmetric key encryption requires a single trusted key per server configuration, but the implementation lacks verification that the key used matches the server’s specified key. This allows any trusted key to authenticate packets, enabling impersonation attacks between clients and servers. Weak digest algorithms (e.g., MD5) in trusted keys exacerbate the risk by allowing attackers to abuse weaker cryptographic methods. The flaw stems from an omission in the authentication verification process in the NTP reference implementation.
discovery_credit: Matt Street
disclosure_timeline: {'vendor_disclosure': '2015-10-07', 'public_release': '2016-01-19'}
product_reference_url: https://talosintelligence.com/vulnerability_reports/TALOS-2016-0071

affected_software: NTP 4.2.8p6

affected_software: Tarantool 1.7.2-0-g8e92715

report_id: TALOS-2020-1100
cve_id: CVE-2020-8620
vulnerability_title: Internet Systems Consortium's BIND TCP Receive Buffer Length Assertion Check Denial of Service Vulnerability
affected_software: Internet Systems Consortium BIND 9.16.1 through 9.17.1
vendor: Internet Systems Consortium
cwe_type: CWE-617 - Reachable Assertion
cvss_vector: CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H
attack_vector: Network
vulnerability_summary: An assertion failure exists within the Internet Systems Consortium’s BIND server versions 9.16.1 through 9.17.1 when processing TCP traffic via the libuv library. Due to a length specified within a callback for the library, flooding the server’s TCP port used for larger DNS requests (AXFR) can cause the libuv library to pass a length to the server which will violate an assertion check in the server’s verifications. This assertion check will terminate the service resulting in a denial of service condition. An attacker can flood the port with unauthenticated packets in order to trigger this vulnerability.
discovery_credit: Discovered by Emanuel Almeida of Cisco Systems, Inc.
disclosure_timeline: {'vendor_disclosure': '2020-07-06', 'patch_release': '2020-08-04', 'public_release': '2020-08-20'}

cve_id: CVE-2015-8158
vulnerability_title: Network Time Protocol ntpq and ntpdc Infinite Loop Vulnerability
affected_software: ntp 4.2.8p3NTPsec aa48d001683e5b791a743ec9c575aaf7d867a2b0c
vendor: NTPsec
cwe_type: N/A
cvss_vector: None
attack_vector: Network
vulnerability_summary: ntpq processes incoming packets in a loop in getresponse(). The loop’s only stopping conditions are receiving a complete and correct response or hitting a small number of error conditions. If the packet contains incorrect values that don’t trigger one of the error conditions, the loop continues to receive new packets. ntpdc suffers from the same issue. This can be leveraged by an attacker to DoS an ntpq or ntpdc client by creating an infinite loop. As long as the incoming packets are not correct and don’t trigger an error condition, the loop will never end.
discovery_credit: Jonathan Gardner
disclosure_timeline: {'vendor_disclosure': '2015-10-16', 'public_release': '2016-01-19'}
product_reference_url: http://www.ntpsec.org/

vulnerability_title: Linux kernel CAM table denial-of-service vulnerability

input:
report_id: TALOS-2016-0132
cve_id: CVE-2016-1551
vulnerability_title: Network Time Protocol ntpd Reference Clock Impersonation Vulnerability
affected_software: NTP 4.2.8p3, NTPsec a5fb34b9cc89b92a8fef2f459004865c93bb7f92
vendor: Cisco Talos
cwe_type: N/A
cvss_vector: CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N
attack_vector: Network
vulnerability_summary: ntpd relies on the underlying operating system to protect it from requests that impersonate reference clocks. Because reference clocks are treated like other peers and stored in the same structure, any packet with a source IP address of a reference clock (e.g., 127.127.1.1) that reaches the receive() function will match that reference clock’s peer record and be treated as a trusted peer. Systems lacking martian packet filtering are vulnerable to attackers controlling time by spoofing these packets. IPv6 spoofing protections exist, but IPv4 spoofed packets with 127.127.x.x addresses are not filtered proactively by ntpd, exposing systems to potential time manipulation attacks.
discovery_credit: Discovered by Matt Street of Cisco ASIG in collaboration with other team members.
disclosure_timeline: {'vendor_disclosure': '2016-01-07', 'public_release': '2016-04-26'}
product_reference_url: https://talosintelligence.com/vulnerability_reports/TALOS-2016-0132
output: [{"evidence": ["CWE type is unspecified but the vulnerability involves improper validation and trust assumptions leading to logic errors", "CVSS vector indicates network attack vector with high attack complexity and no privileges required", "Impact is limited to integrity (time manipulation) without confidentiality or availability impact", "Lack of proper filtering (martian packet filtering) allows spoofed packets to be accepted as trusted", "No evidence of code execution or authentication bypass, indicating a logic flaw rather than injection or access control failure"], "analysis": "First check the CVSS vector for attack complexity and impact scope; then verify the absence of authentication or code execution vectors; finally confirm the vulnerability arises from trust assumptions and improper packet filtering logic; because the flaw is a logic error in handling reference clock packets leading to potential time manipulation, classify as logic_flaw", "official": "logic_flaw", "severity": "medium", "action": "monitor"}]
